{"toolCallId":"tooluse_pszef580YyZRztKMZzOaby","toolName":"fast_apply_tool","argsJson":"{\"path\":\"/src/app/components/FloatingAIButton.tsx\",\"change_str\":\"import { useState, useRef, useEffect } from 'react';\\nimport { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'motion/react';\\nimport { Sparkles, Send, GripVertical, X } from 'lucide-react';\\n\\ninterface Message {\\n  id: string;\\n  text: string;\\n  sender: 'user' | 'ai';\\n  timestamp: Date;\\n}\\n\\nexport function FloatingAIButton() {\\n  const [isHovered, setIsHovered] = useState(false);\\n  const [isExpanded, setIsExpanded] = useState(false);\\n  const [input, setInput] = useState('');\\n  const [isDragging, setIsDragging] = useState(false);\\n  const [messages, setMessages] = useState<Message[]>([]);\\n  const chatEndRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);\\n\\n  const scrollToBottom = () => {\\n    chatEndRef.current?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });\\n  };\\n\\n  useEffect(() => {\\n    scrollToBottom();\\n  }, [messages]);\\n\\n  const handleSubmit = (e: React.FormEvent) => {\\n    e.preventDefault();\\n    if (input.trim()) {\\n      // Add user message\\n      const userMessage: Message = {\\n        id: Date.now().toString(),\\n        text: input,\\n        sender: 'user',\\n        timestamp: new Date(),\\n      };\\n      setMessages((prev) => [...prev, userMessage]);\\n\\n      // Simulate AI response\\n      setTimeout(() => {\\n        const aiMessage: Message = {\\n          id: (Date.now() + 1).toString(),\\n          text: `I received your message: \\\"${input}\\\". This is a mock response from Qwen AI. Connect to the real API for actual responses!`,\\n          sender: 'ai',\\n          timestamp: new Date(),\\n        };\\n        setMessages((prev) => [...prev, aiMessage]);\\n      }, 800);\\n\\n      setInput('');\\n      setIsExpanded(true);\\n    }\\n  };\\n\\n  const toggleExpand = () => {\\n    setIsExpanded(!isExpanded);\\n  };\\n\\n  return (\\n    <motion.div\\n      className=\\\"fixed bottom-8 right-8 z-50 cursor-grab active:cursor-grabbing\\\"\\n      onHoverStart={() => !isDragging && !isExpanded && setIsHovered(true)}\\n      onHoverEnd={() => !isExpanded && setIsHovered(false)}\\n      drag\\n      dragMomentum={false}\\n      dragElastic={0}\\n      onDragStart={() => {\\n        setIsDragging(true);\\n        setIsHovered(false);\\n      }}\\n      onDragEnd={() => {\\n        setTimeout(() => setIsDragging(false), 100);\\n      }}\\n      initial={false}\\n      whileDrag={{ scale: 1.05 }}\\n    >\\n      {/* Chat History Panel */}\\n      <AnimatePresence>\\n        {(isExpanded || isHovered) && messages.length > 0 && (\\n          <motion.div\\n            initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20, height: 0 }}\\n            animate={{ \\n              opacity: 1, \\n              y: 0, \\n              height: isExpanded ? 'auto' : 0,\\n              maxHeight: isExpanded ? '400px' : '0px'\\n            }}\\n            exit={{ opacity: 0, y: 20, height: 0 }}\\n            transition={{ duration: 0.3 }}\\n            className=\\\"absolute bottom-full mb-3 right-0 w-[400px] bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-2xl overflow-hidden\\\"\\n            style={{ pointerEvents: isExpanded ? 'auto' : 'none' }}\\n            onMouseDown={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}\\n          >\\n            {/* Header */}\\n            <div className=\\\"flex items-center justify-between px-4 py-3 bg-gradient-to-r from-purple-600 to-blue-600 text-white\\\">\\n              <div className=\\\"flex items-center gap-2\\\">\\n                <Sparkles className=\\\"w-4 h-4\\\" />\\n                <span className=\\\"font-semibold text-sm\\\">Chat History</span>\\n              </div>\\n              <button\\n                onClick={toggleExpand}\\n                className=\\\"p-1 hover:bg-white/20 rounded-lg transition-colors\\\"\\n              >\\n                <X className=\\\"w-4 h-4\\\" />\\n              </button>\\n            </div>\\n\\n            {/* Messages */}\\n            <div className=\\\"overflow-y-auto max-h-[320px] p-4 space-y-3 bg-gray-50\\\">\\n              {messages.map((message) => (\\n                <div\\n                  key={message.id}\\n                  className={`flex ${message.sender === 'user' ? 'justify-end' : 'justify-start'}`}\\n                >\\n                  <div\\n                    className={`max-w-[80%] rounded-2xl px-4 py-2 ${\\n                      message.sender === 'user'\\n                        ? 'bg-gradient-to-r from-purple-600 to-blue-600 text-white'\\n                        : 'bg-white text-gray-800 shadow-sm border border-gray-200'\\n                    }`}\\n                  >\\n                    <p className=\\\"text-sm\\\">{message.text}</p>\\n                    <p\\n                      className={`text-xs mt-1 ${\\n                        message.sender === 'user' ? 'text-white/70' : 'text-gray-500'\\n                      }`}\\n                    >\\n                      {message.timestamp.toLocaleTimeString('en-US', {\\n                        hour: '2-digit',\\n                        minute: '2-digit',\\n                      })}\\n                    </p>\\n                  </div>\\n                </div>\\n              ))}\\n              <div ref={chatEndRef} />\\n            </div>\\n          </motion.div>\\n        )}\\n      </AnimatePresence>\\n\\n      {/* Input Bar */}\\n      <motion.div\\n        className=\\\"relative flex items-center gap-3 bg-gradient-to-r from-purple-600 to-blue-600 rounded-full shadow-2xl overflow-hidden\\\"\\n        animate={{\\n          width: isHovered || isExpanded ? Connect to the real API for actual responses!`,\\n          sender: 'ai',\\n          timestamp: new Date(),\\n        };\\n        setMessages((prev) => [...prev, aiMessage]);\\n      }, 800);\\n\\n      setInput('');\\n      setIsExpanded(true);\\n    }\\n  };\\n\\n  const toggleExpand = () => {\\n    setIsExpanded(!isExpanded);\\n  };\\n\\n  return (\\n    <motion.div\\n      className=\\\"fixed bottom-8 right-8 z-50 cursor-grab active:cursor-grabbing\\\"\\n      onHoverStart={() => !isDragging && !isExpanded && setIsHovered(true)}\\n      onHoverEnd={() => !isExpanded && setIsHovered(false)}\\n      drag\\n      dragMomentum={false}\\n      dragElastic={0}\\n      onDragStart={() => {\\n        setIsDragging(true);\\n        setIsHovered(false);\\n      }}\\n      onDragEnd={() => {\\n        setTimeout(() => setIsDragging(false), 100);\\n      }}\\n      initial={false}\\n      whileDrag={{ scale: 1.05 }}\\n    >\\n      {/* Chat History Panel */}\\n      <AnimatePresence>\\n        {(isExpanded || isHovered) && messages.length > 0 && (\\n          <motion.div\\n            initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20, height: 0 }}\\n            animate={{ \\n              opacity: 1, \\n              y: 0, \\n              height: isExpanded ? 'auto' : 0,\\n              maxHeight: isExpanded ? '400px' : '0px'\\n            }}\\n            exit={{ opacity: 0, y: 20, height: 0 }}\\n            transition={{ duration: 0.3 }}\\n            className=\\\"absolute bottom-full mb-3 right-0 w-[400px] bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-2xl overflow-hidden\\\"\\n            style={{ pointerEvents: isExpanded ? 'auto' : 'none' }}\\n            onMouseDown={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}\\n          >\\n            {/* Header */}\\n            <div className=\\\"flex items-center justify-between px-4 py-3 bg-gradient-to-r from-purple-600 to-blue-600 text-white\\\">\\n              <div className=\\\"flex items-center gap-2\\\">\\n                <Sparkles className=\\\"w-4 h-4\\\" />\\n                <span className=\\\"font-semibold text-sm\\\">Chat History</span>\\n              </div>\\n              <button\\n                onClick={toggleExpand}\\n                className=\\\"p-1 hover:bg-white/20 rounded-lg transition-colors\\\"\\n              >\\n                <X className=\\\"w-4 h-4\\\" />\\n              </button>\\n            </div>\\n\\n            {/* Messages */}\\n            <div className=\\\"overflow-y-auto max-h-[320px] p-4 space-y-3 bg-gray-50\\\">\\n              {messages.map((message) => (\\n                <div\\n                  key={message.id}\\n                  className={`flex ${message.sender === 'user' ? 'justify-end' : 'justify-start'}`}\\n                >\\n                  <div\\n                    className={`max-w-[80%] rounded-2xl px-4 py-2 ${\\n                      message.sender === 'user'\\n                        ? 'bg-gradient-to-r from-purple-600 to-blue-600 text-white'\\n                        : 'bg-white text-gray-800 shadow-sm border border-gray-200'\\n                    }`}\\n                  >\\n                    <p className=\\\"text-sm\\\">{message.text}</p>\\n                    <p\\n                      className={`text-xs mt-1 ${\\n                        message.sender === 'user' ? 'text-white/70' : 'text-gray-500'\\n                      }`}\\n                    >\\n                      {message.timestamp.toLocaleTimeString('en-US', {\\n                        hour: '2-digit',\\n                        minute: '2-digit',\\n                      })}\\n                    </p>\\n                  </div>\\n                </div>\\n              ))}\\n              <div ref={chatEndRef} />\\n            </div>\\n          </motion.div>\\n        )}\\n      </AnimatePresence>\\n\\n      {/* Input Bar */}\\n      <motion.div\\n        className=\\\"relative flex items-center gap-3 bg-gradient-to-r from-purple-600 to-blue-600 rounded-full shadow-2xl overflow-hidden\\\"\\n        animate={{\\n          width: isHovered || isExpanded ? '400px' : '60px',\\n          height: '60px',\\n          opacity: isHovered || isExpanded ? 1 : 0.7,\\n        }}\\n        transition={{\\n          type: 'spring',\\n          stiffness: 300,\\n          damping: 25,\\n        }}\\n      >\\n        {/* Icon/Logo with drag indicator */}\\n        <motion.div\\n          className=\\\"flex items-center justify-center min-w-[60px] h-[60px] relative\\\"\\n          animate={{\\n            scale: isHovered || isExpanded ? 0.9 : 1,\\n          }}\\n          onClick={messages.length > 0 ? toggleExpand : undefined}\\n        >\\n          <Sparkles className=\\\"w-7 h-7 text-white\\\" />\\n          {!isHovered && !isExpanded && (\\n            <GripVertical className=\\\"w-3 h-3 text-white/50 absolute bottom-1 right-1\\\" />\\n          )}\\n          {messages.length > 0 && !isExpanded && !isHovered && (\\n            <div className=\\\"absolute -top-1 -right-1 w-5 h-5 bg-red-500 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center text-white text-xs font-bold\\\">\\n              {messages.length}\\n            </div>\\n          )}\\n        </motion.div>\\n\\n        {/* Input Field */}\\n        <motion.form\\n          onSubmit={handleSubmit}\\n          className=\\\"flex-1 flex items-center gap-2 pr-3\\\"\\n          initial={{ opacity: 0 }}\\n          animate={{\\n            opacity: isHovered || isExpanded ? 1 : 0,\\n          }}\\n          transition={{ duration: 0.2 }}\\n        >\\n          <input\\n            type=\\\"text\\\"\\n            value={input}\\n            onChange={(e) => setInput(e.target.value)}\\n            placeholder=\\\"Ask Qwen AI...\\\"\\n            className=\\\"flex-1 bg-white/20 border-none outline-none text-white placeholder-white/70 text-sm py-2 px-3 rounded-lg backdrop-blur-sm\\\"\\n            style={{ pointerEvents: isHovered || isExpanded ? 'auto' : 'none' }}\\n            onMouseDown={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}\\n          />\\n          <button\\n            type=\\\"submit\\\"\\n            className=\\\"flex items-center justify-center w-9 h-9 bg-white/20 hover:bg-white/30 rounded-lg transition-colors\\\"\\n            style={{ pointerEvents: isHovered || isExpanded ? 'auto' : 'none' }}\\n            onMouseDown={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}\\n          >\\n            <Send className=\\\"w-4 h-4 text-white\\\" />\\n          </button>\\n        </motion.form>\\n\\n        {/* Glow effect */}\\n        <motion.div\\n          className=\\\"absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-r from-purple-400 to-blue-400 rounded-full blur-xl -z-10\\\"\\n          animate={{\\n            opacity: isHovered || isExpanded ? 0.6 : 0.3,\\n          }}\\n        />\\n      </motion.div>\\n\\n      {/* Label when not hovered */}\\n      <motion.div\\n        className=\\\"absolute -top-10 left-1/2 transform -translate-x-1/2 whitespace-nowrap\\\"\\n        initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 10 }}\\n        animate={{\\n          opacity: !isHovered && !isDragging && !isExpanded ? 1 : 0,\\n          y: !isHovered && !isDragging && !isExpanded ? 0 : 10,\\n        }}\\n        transition={{ duration: 0.2 }}\\n        style={{ pointerEvents: 'none' }}\\n      >\\n        <div className=\\\"bg-gray-900 text-white text-xs py-1.5 px-3 rounded-lg shadow-lg\\\">\\n          Hover for Qwen AI • Drag to move\\n        </div>\\n      </motion.div>\\n    </motion.div>\\n  );\\n}\"}","providerOptions":{}}
